data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a net increase in prior year reserves driven primarily by higher loss estimates for recent natural catastrophe events (notably Winter Storm Elliott and Hurricane Ida), partly offset by reductions for Hurricane Ian and the 2022 Australian floods and by strengthening in 2021 attritional reserves. The report quantifies a $17.2m net increase in prior year reserves on a net basis; a gross movement estimate based on the published gross claims development triangle indicates a modest gross strengthening of approximately $3.7m (USD).

data.data_quality_notes: The Managing Agent text reports a $17.2m NET increase in prior year reserves (net of reinsurance). A GROSS prior year movement is not explicitly stated. A gross prior-year movement was estimated from the gross claims development table (triangle) which only provides UW years 2021-2023; that triangle-derived gross movement (approximately +3.7m USD) is a fallback calculation and is of lower confidence than a direct gross movement disclosure. All monetary figures are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD).
